record.issuing_body: Vermont General Assembly (2025-2026 session; lead sponsor Rep. Daisy Berbeco); approved by the Governor
record.notes: Approved by the Governor on 17 Jun 2026; the act takes effect on passage, so it has applied since that date. Its stated purpose is to protect people seeking mental health services in Vermont from psychological harm, including death by suicide, by ensuring that the services are delivered by mental health professionals and not independently by AI systems. It creates 18 V.S.A. § 7115 (prohibited uses of artificial intelligence), makes prohibited AI use by a mental health professional unprofessional conduct under 3 V.S.A. § 129a and 26 V.S.A. § 1354, and adds the Director of Professional Regulation and the Executive Director of the Vermont Board of Medical Practice to the Artificial Intelligence Advisory Council (3 V.S.A. § 5023). A violation by a corporation or entity is a violation of the Consumer Protection Act, with the same powers for the Attorney General and the same remedies for private parties.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: re-read the Vermont General Assembly status page for H.816 (stored again 17 Oct 2026), the Committee of Conference report on H.816 and the Office of Legislative Counsel act summary for Act 156 (both stored 12 Oct 2026), and Act No. 156 as enacted, stored in this run; all from legislature.vermont.gov. The enacted act confirms the title, the provisions in the summary and notes, the effective-date clause ('This act shall take effect on passage') and 'Date Governor signed bill: June 17, 2026'; its text matches the conference report. The status page confirms Act 156, the sponsors, the Governor's approval and the statutes affected; the act summary gives the 17 Jun 2026 effective date. The stored files do not name the Governor, so the issuing body no longer does. A House calendar of 29 May 2026 stored with the record does not mention H.816.

judgment.unchanged_judgment_fields: summary, safety_topics and related re-read against the stored files and kept
judgment.status_reasoning: The status page's last recorded action is 'Governor approved bill on June 17, 2026'; the enacted act's Sec. 7 says 'This act shall take effect on passage' and records 'Date Governor signed bill: June 17, 2026', and the Legislative Counsel's act summary gives 'Effective Date: June 17, 2026'. 17 Jun 2026 is before 18 Oct 2026, and the status page shows no later action. 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific state law prohibiting AI-delivered mental health services outside professional oversight; in scope with no note (unchanged).
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the Governor's approval, 17 Jun 2026 (enacted act and status page); date_in_force is the same day, because the act takes effect on passage (Sec. 7) and the act summary gives that effective date.
